title: Prisma Queries & Mutations
description: Learn Prisma Client queries including findMany, findUnique, findFirst, create, update, delete, upsert, filtering, sorting, and pagination.
longDescription: This module covers the core Prisma Client query API. You will learn how to read data using findMany, findUnique, and findFirst, how to modify data with create, update, delete, and upsert, and how to apply filtering, sorting, pagination, and select/include for efficient queries.
whatYouLearn: Use findMany, findUnique, and findFirst to read data
Perform create, update, delete, and upsert operations
Apply filtering and sorting to queries
Implement pagination with cursor and offset strategies
Optimize queries with select and include
